title: Maria's Healthy Day
text:
Maria wants to be healthy. Every morning, she drinks a glass of water. She eats fruit and vegetables for lunch. She walks to school with her friend.

After school, Maria plays football in the park. She sleeps for nine hours every night. Her family says she is happy and strong.

questions.text: What does Maria drink every morning?
What does Maria play after school?
How does Maria probably feel after she sleeps well?

vocabulary.definition: good for your body and in good condition
plants or parts of plants that people eat as food
a clear liquid that people drink
a sport played by two teams kicking a ball

paragraph_translations: Maria quer ser saudável. Todas as manhãs, ela bebe um copo de água. Ela come frutas e legumes no almoço. Ela vai para a escola com a amiga.
Depois da escola, Maria joga futebol no parque. Ela dorme nove horas todas as noites. Sua família diz que ela é feliz e forte.
